title: About Me
text:
01 / THE STORY SO FAR
      My journey.
      
        Three chapters that have shaped the way
        I think, learn, and work.
      
    

    

      
        01

        
          ALMATY, KAZAKHSTAN
          The Foundation
          
            I studied Mathematical and Computer Modeling
            at SDU University, where I developed my
            foundation in quantitative thinking,
            technology, programming, and problem-solving.
          
        

        2020 — 2024
      

      
        02

        
          SDU UNIVERSITY
          Putting Ideas into Practice
          
            Working in project management across the
            Automation Department and TechnoPark gave
            me the opportunity to work with teams,
            support technology-driven projects,
            and see how ideas develop into real outcomes.
          
        

        2024 — 2025
      

      
        03

        
          BOSTON, USA
          A New Chapter
          
            At Boston University, I'm pursuing my
            master's degree in Applied Business
            Analytics, bringing together my technical
            background with business strategy,
            statistical modeling, and data-driven
            decision-making.
          
        

        2025 — PRESENT
      

    

  


  

  

    
      02 / MY APPROACH
      How I think & work.

      
        Beyond tools and technical skills,
        these are the principles I try to bring
        into every project.
      
    

    

      
        01

        Think analytically.

        
          Understand the problem before choosing
          the tools. Ask questions, explore the
          evidence, and look for what really matters.
        
      

      
        02

        Connect the dots.

        
          Bring together technical insights,
          people, and business goals. I believe
          the most useful solutions often come
          from connecting different perspectives.
        
      

      
        03

        Make it useful.

        
          Turn findings into something people
          can actually act on. Good analysis
          should help make decisions clearer
          and outcomes better.
        
      

    

  


  

  

    
      
        03 / THE PERSONAL SIDE
        Beyond the numbers.
      

      
        There's more to life than datasets,
        deadlines, and project plans.
        I enjoy discovering new places,
        collecting memories, and finding
        inspiration in everyday experiences.
      
    

    

      
        
        PLACES & PERSPECTIVES
      

      
        
        LITTLE ADVENTURES
      

      
        
        EVERYDAY MOMENTS
      

    

  


  

  

    04 / THE NEXT CHAPTER

    Still learning.
      Still exploring.
    

    
      I'm interested in opportunities where
      analytical thinking, technology, and
      business meet. As I continue developing
      my skills, I'm looking forward to
      applying what I've learned to real
      problems, collaborating with different
      teams, and discovering where I can make
      the greatest contribution.
    

    
      Let's connect ↗

title: About Me
text:
Currently, I’m pursuing my master’s in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. Previously, I worked in project management at SDU University in Kazakhstan, coordinating teams, managing documentation, and supporting process improvements. These experiences shaped my interest in how data and strategy come together to create meaningful business outcomes.

title: About Me
text:
Turning Questions Into Insights
What interests me most about analytics is the connection between numbers and real business questions. I enjoy exploring a problem, identifying patterns, and figuring out what the results can tell us.
For me, analysis becomes valuable when it explains what is happening, why it matters, and what could be done next.
My project management experience has shaped how I approach analytical work. I value structure, attention to detail, and clear communication while keeping the bigger business objective in mind.

title: About Me
text:
Curious About the World, Too
My curiosity extends beyond data and business. I love exploring new cities, discovering local cafés, noticing interesting architecture, and experiencing different cultures. Traveling gives me a chance to step outside my usual routine and see familiar things from a different perspective.
My curiosity about the world has helped broaden my horizons and inspired my journey into international education and career development.

title: About Me
text:
What I’m Exploring Next
I’m continuing to build my skills in Python, SQL, data visualization, and business intelligence while applying analytical methods to real business problems.
I want to bring together my project coordination experience and analytical training to contribute to projects where data and business strategy meet.
